title: The Price Puzzle: What Drives the Market

topics.title: Demand and the Law of Demand

concepts.learning_objective: Define demand as willingness backed by ability to pay and state the inverse price-quantity relationship.
Derive market demand by adding individual demand schedules and interpret the demand curve.
Explain how price changes of substitutes and complements affect the demand for a good.
Explain how income, tastes, population, seasonality and diminishing marginal utility shape demand.
Explain how expected future prices change present demand.

topics.title: Supply and the Law of Supply

concepts.learning_objective: State the direct relationship between price and quantity supplied and the reason behind it.
Derive market supply by adding individual supplies and read the upward-sloping supply curve.
Explain how prices of alternative products and the number of sellers affect supply.
Explain how technology and producers' future expectations change supply.
Identify equilibrium price and quantity and distinguish excess demand from excess supply.
Explain why real-world equilibrium keeps shifting, using examples like masks and hotel tariffs.

topics.title: Role of Government in the Economy

concepts.learning_objective: Explain price ceilings, price floors, monopoly regulation and the role of regulators.
Explain why public goods are provided by the government rather than private firms.
Evaluate how price distortions, compliance burdens and heavy regulation can harm markets.
